method: Official GitHub Docs personally read via web search/open/find; only short necessary excerpts retained, no third-party full text in Git.

sources.short_quote: Only users with push access will receive listings for draft releases.
sources.observed_generic_get_permission: Get a release lists Contents repository permissions (read), and describes public releases.
sources.interpretation: Draft visibility is restricted separately; generic read minimum does not promise draft access. Using repo Contents write/push for this draft workflow is supported by official visibility rule and observed integration403, not a claim that every GET release always requires write.

sources.observed_details: Explicitly unspecified permission buckets become none; contents write covers repository-content/release write capability.
sources.interpretation: contents read to write is a real GitHub repository permission increase, limited to one bucket and one single-job workflow; not write-all, and not a Modal/HF authority change.

sources.paraphrase: Workflow or job permissions can modify GITHUB_TOKEN privileges; grant the least access required for that workflow.
